tweets.text:
Pricing in AI.... is variable. AI-native companies are rapidly changing thier pricing models every 3-6 months. In 2022, pricing models didn't vary that much. Now, we see companies charging at the closest auditable proxy to value where the core definition of value continously changes. What have you tried? 

Per human seat 
Enterprise-wide license
Per deployed AI agent / digital worker
Per token  per GPU-second / minute / hour
Flat per-production-model VPC license
Prepaid commit-and-burn-down compute
Per generated character   
Per generated audio minute
Per voice-call minute 
Per message or agent action
Per customer session / conversation
Per completed multi-step workflow
Per domain or asset tested 
Per successful resolution
Bespoke business outcome
Percentage of recovered value / success fee
Credits spanning heterogeneous actions
Fixed  platform fee + variable meter
Subscription allowance + overage
Annual  minimum + outcome kicker
Premium content / data bundle
Implementation  / custom-development fee
Volume tiers and negotiated enterprise discounts
Risk-adjusted active agent hour
Concurrent channel or agent capacity 
Per search, page or enrichment record
Sponsored   attention / advertising
Milestones, royalties and strategic license
Recurring managed operations / FDE
Congrats to @anyscalecompute & @robertnishihara on the Anyscale acqusition for 1.65B!!!! https://t.co/5eFKTC2u7C
